preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained owner privileges)
Victim must hold some MARVIN tokens to be affected by high fees

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call updateBuyFees() and updateSellFees() to set fees to the maximum allowed (50%). Then perform trades (buy/sell) with victim addresses to extract excessive fees. The fees will accumulate in the contract and be distributed to marketingWallet and devWallet (both controlled by owner). Finally, trigger swapBack() to convert tokens to ETH and collect the funds.
